ziel: Can shipping work without eating the margin?

serie.name: Online shop for handmade ceramics
rueckblick: Session 1: PILOT 6/10. Demand is real, margins are thin.
Open: shipping cost and breakage can eat the margin (E-commerce expert).
Open: can 30 pieces a month be produced next to a day job?

teilnehmer.name: Mia
teilnehmer.fokus: raised the shipping risk in session 1

gespraech.text: In session 1, Mia warned that shipping could eat the margin. Today we only look at that.
Ceramics need double boxing. That adds about €2.50 per order in material and five minutes of packing.
Then bundle: free shipping from two pieces. A single mug ships at cost.
I accept €4.90 shipping for one mug. For two pieces I expect it to be free.
With bundles the average order is €78. Shipping and packaging stay under 12% of revenue.
Only if breakage stays below 2%. Test 20 parcels before you promise anything.

fazit.note_fuer: chance of a profitable side business in 12 months
fazit.begruendung: Bundling and double boxing make shipping manageable. The overall verdict improves from PILOT 6/10 to GO WITH CONDITIONS 7/10.

kritikpunkte.text: Breakage rate is still an assumption
Packing time is not yet part of the production plan

verbesserungen.warum: raises the average order and spreads the shipping cost
measures the real breakage rate before launch

fazit.wichtigste_bedingung: Breakage stays below 2% in the 20-parcel test.
fazit.naechster_schritt: Pack and ship 20 test parcels this month and count the breakage.
naechste_sitzung: Production time next to a day job
